rules: Every batch must provide an explicit replay allowlist.
Every replay outside the allowlist must be refused before reading, hashing, opening, copying, or parsing.
Allowlist entries must include replayId, expected local path, intended mode, and authorization source.
A replay authorized for dry_run_readiness is not automatically authorized for death_validation_compact_emission.
A replay authorized in one task is not automatically authorized in later tasks.
firstMiniPilotEligibilityBasis: already validated through parser completion and compact death_validation emission in prior accepted tasks; must still be explicitly reauthorized in the future task
